name: The Great Indian Kapil Show
description: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.

videos.title: Ranbir - The Real Family Man
videos.overview: The luminous Kapoor family — Ranbir, Neetu and Riddhima — arrive right on time for candid conversations and rollicking jokes at Kapil's new airport cafe.

videos.title: Cricket Fever - Rohit and Shreyas
videos.overview: Rohit Sharma and Shreyas Iyer are men of the match as they hit funny fours and side-splitting sixes for every one of captain Kapil’s slapstick swings.

videos.title: Stars of Chamkila
videos.overview: Diljit Dosanjh, Parineeti Chopra and Imtiaz Ali shine and dazzle as they join Kapil and his entertaining bandmates on a humorous musical adventure.

videos.title: Brothers in Arms - Vicky and Sunny Kaushal
videos.overview: It's time for some sibling fun as Vicky and Sunny Kaushal recall playful childhood memories with Kapil and his wacky cast of comedians.

videos.title: Aamir Unlimited
videos.overview: Will the real Aamir Khan please stand up? The legendary actor regales Kapil and the audience with hilarious on-set stories and moments of movie magic.

videos.title: ⁠Dil Se Deol - Sunny and Bobby
videos.overview: Sunny and Bobby Deol are ready for takeoff! The celebrity brothers flex their comedic skills on Kapil’s stage with charades and audience chatter.

videos.title: Diamonds of Heeramandi
videos.overview: Heeramandi’s crown jewels — Manisha Koirala, Sonakshi Sinha, Aditi Rao Hydari, Richa Chadha, Sanjeeda Sheikh and Sharmin Segal hold court with Kapil.

videos.title: The Perfect Artist - Ed Sheeran
videos.overview: Pop star Ed Sheeran tries his hand at Hindi and serenades the crowd with a Bhangra rendition of “Shape of You” as Kapil hilariously dabbles in English.

videos.title: Fun With Friends - Anil Kapoor and Farah Khan
videos.overview: The multi-talented Farah Khan and the ageless Anil Kapoor define friendship goals as they spill hilariously intriguing secrets about the film industry.

videos.title: Perfect Partnership - Janhvi Kapoor and Rajkumar Rao
videos.overview: Rajkummar Rao and Janhvi Kapoor have the perfect on-screen partnership as they join Kapil to exchange compliments and play guessing games.

videos.title: Game Changers - Sania, Saina, Mary Kom and Sift Kaur
videos.overview: Sports champs Mary Kom, Sania Mirza and Saina Nehwal match Kapil point for point — and punch for punch! Olympic contender Sift Kaur Samra joins the fun.

videos.title: Kings of Hip Hop - Badshah, Divine and Karan Aujla
videos.overview: Badshah, Divine and Karan Aujla drop the beat on Kapil's stage with a fun musical performance while also tuning into gags, laughs and skits.

videos.title: Kartik Aaryan and Khandaan
videos.overview: Mother-son duo Kartik Aaryan and Dr. Mala Tiwari bring a host of hilarious stories to the stage as well as a special guest — Kartik's dog, Katori!

videos.title: Bonded By Love - Alia Bhatt, Karan Johar, Vedang Raina and Vasan Bala
videos.overview: It’s all about heartfelt bonds as Kapil welcomes Alia Bhatt, Karan Johar, Vedang Raina and Vasan Bala into the fold — with his trademark wit, of course.

videos.title: South Sensations - NTR, Saif Ali Khan and Janhvi Kapoor
videos.overview: Bollywood and Tollywood come together as NTR, Janhvi Kapoor and Saif Ali Khan sail the seas of laughter with Kapil as the ship captain.

videos.title: World Cup Champions - Rohit Sharma, Suryakumar Yadav, Axar Patel, Arshdeep Singh and Shivam Dube
videos.overview: The World Cup champions — Rohit Sharma, Suryakumar Yadav, Axar Patel, Arshdeep Singh and Shivam Dube — join Kapil and gang for a round of celebrations.

videos.title: Superstar Sisters - Kareena and Karisma
videos.overview: Can Kapil keep up with the Kapoors? Kareena and Karisma look back at their legacy at the movies and the bond that makes their sisterhood iconic.

videos.title: Karwa Chauth with the Fabulous Wives
videos.overview: Delhi or Mumbai — which is more fabulous? Maheep, Bhavana, Seema, Neelam, Shalini, Kalyani and Riddhima help Kapil decide in this Karva Chauth special.

videos.title: Double Trouble with Kriti and Kajol
videos.overview: There’s twice the delight, twice the amusement and twice the surprises as Kapil plays host to Kajol and Kriti Sanon.

videos.title: Bhoot Bhari Diwali
videos.overview: Kartik Aaryan, Tripti Dimri, Vidya Balan, Rajpal Yadav and Anees Bazmee bring fireworks, frights and fun to Kapil’s thrilling Diwali party.

videos.title: Business Baazigars - Sudha Murthy, Narayan Murthy, Deepinder Goyal and Gia Goyal
videos.overview: Wit and wisdom take the stage as Kapil hosts two iconic couples in business and entrepreneurship — Narayana and Sudha Murthy and Deepinder and Gia Goyal.

videos.title: Punjab Ke Sher - Navjot Singh Sidhu & Harbhajan Singh
videos.overview: Navjot Singh Sidhu teams up with Harbhajan Singh for a grand return to Kapil’s stage, as they expertly match one-liners alongside their better halves.

videos.title: Shotgun with the Sinhas
videos.overview: Shatrughan and Poonam Sinha take Kapil’s stage with newlyweds Sonakshi and Zaheer to share candid stories of their enduring familial bond.

videos.title: Entertainer No. 1 - Govinda, Chunky Panday & Shakti Kapoor
videos.overview: Get ready for non-stop laughter as old pals Govinda, Chunky Panday and Shakti Kapoor amp up the entertainment factor with a splash of ’90s nostalgia.

videos.title: Evergreen Icon - Rekha
videos.overview: She is an icon. She is a legend. She is the moment. Rekha graces Kapil’s stage, enthralling him with anecdotes from her extraordinary life.

videos.title: Varun In Action
videos.overview: Action and comedy collide as Varun Dhawan joins Kapil for a banter-filled conversation alongside Wamiqa Gabbi, Keerthy Suresh and Atlee.

videos.title: Being Salman
videos.overview: Megastar Salman Khan kicks off Kapil's new season with his kindness and charm, answering juicy rapid-fire questions and delivering big laughs.

videos.title: Metro Masti
videos.overview: The laughs keep rolling as Kapil's path collides with the vibrant "Metro… In Dino" gang, as they participate in fun-filled games and share quirky tales.

videos.title: Coach and the Cricketers
videos.overview: A calm coach meets Indian cricket's wild bunch (and Kapil). Gambhir, Pant, Chahal and Sharma serve laughs, banter and a dose of dressing-room chemistry.

videos.title: Streaming Superstars
videos.overview: Kapil's stage brims with fun as streaming stars Jaideep, Vijay, Pratik and Jitendra trade laughs, memories and moves — plus a surprise superfan visit.

videos.title: Sardaron Ka Swag
videos.overview: Ajay Devgn flaunts his wit and charm like never before as he, Ravi Kishan, Mrunal Thakur and the spirited cast of "Son of Sardaar 2" take the stage.

videos.title: Mic Drop with Podcasters
videos.overview: India's leading YouTube stars join Kapil for an evening filled with humorous takes, zany quips and thought-provoking anecdotes.

videos.title: Parineeti - Raghav ki Prem Sabha
videos.overview: Couple Parineeti Chopra and Raghav Chadha share good-natured ribbing and heartfelt insights on marriage in a sparkling conversation with Kapil.

videos.title: Dil Dosti Bhai-Behen
videos.overview: It's always more fun with siblings! Join Shilpa Shetty, Shamita Shetty, Huma Qureshi and Saqib Saleem as they put their chemistry and candor on display.

videos.title: Musical Mehfil
videos.overview: Vishal Dadlani, Sheykhar Ravjiani, Shaan and Neeti Mohan take Kapil's stage for a heartfelt and joyous musical tribute to India's unity and spirit.

videos.title: Business Ke Gamechangers
videos.overview: Vijay Shekhar Sharma, Ritesh Agarwal, Ghazal Alagh and Aman Gupta spill the tea on the gutsy moves that made them startup superstars.

videos.title: Love and Laughs with Param Sundari
videos.overview: Cultures collide and comedy takes over as Janhvi Kapoor, Sidharth Malhotra and the cast of "Param Sundari" match wits with Kapil and his crew.

videos.title: Yaaron Ka Adda
videos.overview: Style meets swagger as Bollywood icons Sanjay Dutt and Suniel Shetty reunite on Kapil's stage to relive the good old days.

videos.title: South Superheroes
videos.overview: "Mirai" stars Teja Sajja, Ritika Nayak, Jagapathi Babu and Shriya Saran light up Kapil's show, celebrating South Indian cinema's growing impact.

videos.title: Khiladi Returns
videos.overview: He's a superstar like no other. Join Akshay Kumar as he takes on Kapil with sharp wit, cheeky roasts and electric dance moves.

videos.title: Desi Girl, Global Swag - Priyanka Chopra
videos.overview: It's the homecoming of Priyanka Chopra Jonas. Join Kapil as she shares her movie-star charm, reflects on life abroad and gabs about her popstar husband.

videos.title: Queens Of Cricket
videos.overview: The women's World Cup champs bring spunky energy and cheeky humor to Kapil's rollicking celebration, featuring special surprises and unseen talents.

videos.title: New Year, New Love - Kartik Aaryan and Ananya Panday
videos.overview: Heartthrobs Kartik Aaryan and Ananya Panday bring rom-com vibes to Kapil's stage, with Gen-Z banter and plenty of hilarious gags.

videos.title: Blockbuster Bhojpuri Stars - Manoj Tiwari, Dinesh Lal Yadav and Pawan Singh
videos.overview: Kapil welcomes Bhojpuri superstars Manoj Tiwari, Dinesh Lal Yadav and Pawan Singh as they regale audiences with fun anecdotes and iconic songs.

videos.title: Dosti ki Hattrick - Yuvraj Singh, Virender Sehwag and Mohammad Kaif
videos.overview: From fours and sixes to a lifelong friendship, Yuvraj Singh, Virender Sehwag and Mohammad Kaif relive cricketing nostalgia with Kapil.

videos.title: Fierce and Fabulous - Rani Mukerji
videos.overview: On-screen she's the toughest cop in the room; off-screen she dazzles with charm. Rani Mukerji opens up about her craft and marriage with Kapil.

videos.title: Bolti Bandh, Laughter On - Vijay Sethupathi, Aditi Rao Hydari, AR Rahman, Siddharth Jadhav
videos.overview: Silence on set! Vijay Sethupathi, Aditi Rao Hydari, A. R. Rahman and Siddharth Jadhav fill Kapil's show with laughter.

videos.title: Brown Munde - AP Dhillon and Anubhav Singh Bassi
videos.overview: One has vibrant musical energy. The other packs comedic flair. AP Dhillon and Anubhav Singh Bassi bring the best of global Indian talent to Kapil's show.

videos.title: Romeo ki Valentine - Shahid Kapoor, Triptii Dimri, Avinash Tiwary, Farida Jalal, Vishal Bhardwaj
videos.overview: Celebrate Valentine’s Day with Shahid Kapoor, Triptii Dimri, Avinash Tiwary, Farida Jalal and Vishal Bhardwaj as gags collide with love and laughter.

videos.title: Jab Bhidu Went Dhak Dhak
videos.overview: Their 90s roots bring love and charm wherever they go. Madhuri Dixit and Jackie Shroff take a walk down memory lane with Kapil.

videos.title: Masti Ki Paathshala - Alakh Pandey, Nitin Vijay, Khan Sir
videos.overview: When the wisdom of Alakh Pandey, Nitin Vijay and Khan Sir meets Kapil’s wit, it's not hard to find the fun in learning.

videos.title: Masti Ka Mahamix
videos.overview: Get ready for hilarious banter and never-ending laughs as Ravi Kishan, Orry and Malaika Arora take centerstage with Kapil.

videos.title: Family No. 1 - David Dhawan and Varun Dhawan
videos.overview: Comedy chaos ensues as the "No. 1" father-son duo meets Kapil! David and Varun Dhawan bring playful roasts and Bollywood throwbacks to the season finale.

videos.title: The Return of Samay Raina and Ranveer Allahbadia
videos.overview: On this World Laughter Day, YouTube sensations Samay Raina and Ranveer Allahbadia join Kapil for a hilariously unfiltered and cheeky conversation.
